In a cash basis system where there weren't huge incentives for employers to provide health insurance with boku regulation to go with it, I'd pop my physician's office an email saying "no change in medical status, I had the staff nurse at work check my blood pressure, here's what it is", and some low level nurse at that office would email me a prescription approval and bill me $5-10 for two minutes of work instead of taking up an hour of a physician's time + insurance billing overhead.
